evidence_required: The implied rate against line rate, and the conclusion with plausible causes.

marking.criterion: Implied rate 40 GB / 0.5 s = 80 GB/s computed with units
Compared with 400 Gb/s = 50 GB/s line rate and declared impossible (ceiling fraction 1.6)
At least two plausible data causes (TX + RX summed, two NICs aggregated, bits/bytes confusion, wrong time window)

title: A profile that exceeds NIC line rate
